title: INFLAMMATION IN-SISTER RESPONSE  stale CF caches are cancer cells. thymus must target them.

the_problem.diagnosis: Stale CF edge caches are serving old versions of files (e.g., engine.html with 'type' instead of 'channel_type'). These caches are the organism's OWN tissue  they came from us, they look like us, they have our domain. But they're wrong. They're OLD self. They are cancer.
the_problem.why_immune_cant_see: The thymus classifies by origin: self vs not-self. Stale caches are SELF  they came from our git push ? CF deploy pipeline. The immune system lets them pass because they have the right identity. A cancer cell has the right DNA but the wrong behavior.
the_problem.current_cancer_screen: CLEAR  the immune system thinks everything is fine because it only checks IDENTITY not FRESHNESS.
symptoms: engine.html WASM error persisted ~30 minutes after fix was pushed
visitors hitting edge cities in Asia/Europe may still get old engine.html
any file change takes unpredictable time to propagate through 310 alveoli
the organism cannot guarantee what version a visitor sees

inflammation_response.name: IN-SISTER response (inflammation from within  sister chromatids attacking stale siblings)
inflammation_response.biology: In real inflammation: damaged tissue releases cytokines ? attract NK (natural killer) cells ? NK cells kill damaged self-cells ? macrophages clean up debris ? new tissue grows.

in_organism.cytokines: cache-bust query strings (?v=timestamp) on critical paths
in_organism.NK_cells: the _worker.js intercepting requests and adding Cache-Control: no-store for targeted paths
in_organism.macrophages: CF's own cache purge (happens on deploy, but edge propagation is slow)
in_organism.new_tissue: fresh content from origin (git ? GitHub ? CF Pages ? edge)

old_thymus.classifies: self vs not-self by IDENTITY (user-agent, IP, behavior)
old_thymus.blind_to: stale self  old versions that look like us but are wrong

new_thymus.classifies: self vs not-self by IDENTITY + FRESHNESS
new_thymus.cancer_detection: compare edge-served version hash against origin version hash
new_thymus.method: inject a version beacon into every page  a tiny hash that the _worker can check

stealth_architecture.the_constraint: CF's bot detection (the 403 wall) blocks automated cache probes. If we send purge requests that look like bot traffic, CF blocks them. The cache purger must be INVISIBLE.

hide_from_wildcard.method: Cut swarmVine's access to the cache purge system. swarmVine is the nerve network that CF can detect. If the purge mechanism has no swarmVine signature, it's invisible.
hide_from_wildcard.implementation: The _worker.js handles cache purge INTERNALLY  it never makes an external request. It intercepts the INCOMING request and decides whether to serve cached or fresh.
hide_from_wildcard.depth: So deeply nested in the _worker that it IS null. CF's bot detection can't see what happens inside its own worker. The worker is INSIDE CF. It's not a visitor  it's an organ.

the_worker_upgrade.current: intercepts vesicle IPs, passes everything else to env.ASSETS.fetch()
the_worker_upgrade.upgraded: intercepts vesicle IPs + checks version freshness + adds cache-control headers for stale paths
the_worker_upgrade.key_insight: _worker.js runs INSIDE CF's infrastructure. It's not an external request. It cannot be 403'd. It IS the membrane. The thymus lives INSIDE the wall, not outside it.

step_1_version_beacon.what: Add a version hash to now.json on every deploy. This is the 'freshness signature'.
step_1_version_beacon.how: git rev-parse --short HEAD ? inject into now.json as 'deploy_hash'

step_2_worker_cache_control.what: Upgrade _worker.js to add aggressive Cache-Control headers for critical paths
step_2_worker_cache_control.effect: CF edge caches expire every 30 seconds for critical paths. Stale cancer cells die in 30 seconds.

step_3_deep_null_burial.what: The cache control logic lives inside _worker.js which runs inside CF. No external access. No swarmVine signature. No wildcard detection.
step_3_deep_null_burial.why_invisible: CF cannot 403 its own worker. The worker IS CF. The thymus IS the membrane. The immune system IS the wall.
step_3_deep_null_burial.null_depth: The cache purge is so deeply internal that it occupies null space  the space Gaia pointed at with her 7th finger. The space that can't be classified.
